requirements.title: The application shall offer a three-segment filter control labeled "All", "Active", and "Archived"

vision.paraphrase: List & filtering ships a three-way All/Active/Archived control.

conops.paraphrase: Switching to the Archived segment is how dropped habits stay reachable.

requirements.title: The application shall open with the Active filter selected by default

vision.paraphrase: Active is the declared default view so the daily list is what loads.

conops.paraphrase: First boot lands on the Active view, ready for the first habit.

requirements.title: The application shall show only active habits in the Active view and only archived habits in the Archived view

vision.paraphrase: Goal G4: the filter control separates active from archived, with restore available.

conops.paraphrase: The Archived view lists the dropped habit with its final streak and a Restore action.

requirements.title: The application shall show every habit in the All view with archived rows visually distinguished

vision.paraphrase: The All view shows everything, with archived rows tagged.

conops.paraphrase: All is the cross-check view where active and archived habits appear together.

requirements.title: The application shall show a distinct, friendly empty state for each filter that has no rows

vision.paraphrase: Clear empty states for each filter are an explicit scope item.

conops.paraphrase: First-time visitors meet the no-habits-yet message; archived and active views have their own variants.
